opportunities.name: Movie night invite with IMDb and Rotten Tomatoes ratings
opportunities.description: For a given movie, get the director, runtime and IMDb rating from IMDb and the Tomatometer score from Rotten Tomatoes, then write a movie-night email to a friend for a given day.
steps: Open imdb.com and decline the cookie banner if it appears
Type {movie_title} in 'Search IMDb' and press Enter
Click the matching title in the results; note the IMDb rating, director and runtime
Open rottentomatoes.com and reject the cookie banner if it appears
Type {movie_title} in the Search box and press Enter
Click the matching movie in the results; note the Tomatometer %
Open the mail compose page
Fill 'To' with {recipient_email}
Fill 'Subject' with 'Movie night {day}: {movie_title}'
Fill 'Body' with 'Hi {recipient_name}, {day} we watch {movie_title} ({director}, {runtime}): IMDb {imdb_rating}, Tomatometer {tomatometer}%.'
Send the email (the user clicked Discard in the recording)

instances.values: movie=The Grand Budapest Hotel (lookups only; no email was written in the recording)

opportunities.name: npm package stats summary to Notes
opportunities.description: For a given npm package, get the version, weekly downloads and license from npmjs, then the stars, open issues and latest release date from its GitHub repo, and save a one-line summary note.
steps: Open npmjs.com
Type {package_name} in 'Search packages' and press Enter
Click the exact-match package in the results
Note the version, weekly downloads and license
Click the Repository link (github.com/...)
Note the stars and open issues, then click 'Releases' and note the latest release date
Open Notes, click 'New note'
Type '{package}: v{version}, {weekly_downloads}/week, {license}, {stars} stars, {open_issues} open issues, last release {release_date}' and press Enter

instances.values: package=express (stopped after opening the npm package page)

opportunities.name: Recipe and dish-origin note
opportunities.description: For a given dish and number of servings, find the top recipe on Allrecipes (rating, total time, first ingredients), look up the dish's origin on Wikipedia, and save a summary note.
steps: Open allrecipes.com
Type {dish} in 'Find a recipe or ingredient' and press Enter
Click the top recipe in the results and close any popup
Note the recipe name, star rating, total time and first 3 ingredients
Open wikipedia.org, close the donation banner if present
Type {dish} in 'Search Wikipedia' and press Enter
Read 'Place of origin' in the infobox
Open Notes, click 'New note'
Type '{dish} for {servings}: {recipe_name} ({rating} stars, {time}), needs {ingredients}. Origin: {origin}' and press Enter

instances.values: dish=shakshuka, servings=4 (Chef John's Shakshuka, origin Ottoman North Africa)
